blocks.text: LUCENA CITY – Two crew members were injured after a fire of still undetermined origin broke out aboard a motor tanker at a port at Calaca City in Batangas on Wednesday night (Sept. 30). In a report, the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) – Southern Tagalog District said the fire started in the engine room of motor tanker “GINDARA” while it was docked at the Balayan Distillery Inc. port in Barangay Talisay.
